intent: The short text that describes a drawer's panel, under its title.
typical_uses: One sentence telling the user what the panel is for

dont_use_when.situation: Body text inside the panel that does not summarize it

instead.note: Only the description is announced with the panel; other text is ordinary content.

dont_use_when.situation: The description of an edge panel with no swipe gesture
The description of a centered dialog

invariants.text: DrawerDescription renders a p in the body type ramp with the muted foreground color and balanced line wrapping.

anti_patterns.dont: Put paragraphs of instructions in DrawerDescription
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep it to a sentence and put longer text in the panel's body, since the whole description is announced when the panel opens

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the description's state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property; the primitive passes an empty state object.

style.states: style accepts a function as well as a plain style object; the primitive passes that function an empty state object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)`, and the description's state carries no fields. The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through drawer.module.css, not through this.

good.title: A description under the title
good.code:
<DrawerHeader>
  <DrawerTitle>Share</DrawerTitle>
  <DrawerDescription>Anyone with the link can view this file.</DrawerDescription>
</DrawerHeader>

bad.title: A description outside the panel
bad.code:
<Drawer>
  <DrawerDescription>Anyone with the link can view this file.</DrawerDescription>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerTitle>Share</DrawerTitle>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
bad.why: Placed beside DrawerContent it renders in the page, not in the panel, so the page shows the text even while the drawer is closed.
